name: Andaz Ottawa Byward Market
positioning: Andaz Ottawa ByWard Market: a boutique hotel in the ByWard Market near downtown Ottawa, with floor-to-ceiling city views and the city's highest rooftop lounge
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Parliament and the National Gallery of Canada
Guests who want rooftop cocktails with views of Parliament Hill

facts.text: The hotel is in the ByWard Market area near downtown Ottawa.
Rooms and suites feature locally inspired touches and floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the city of Ottawa.
Rooms offer rain showers and 400-thread-count linens.
Rooms include large format refillable Byredo body care.
The Andaz Suite has a separate living area and an oversized bathroom with rain shower and deep-soaking tub.
Chef Matthew McRae leads the hotel's ByWard Market restaurant, Feast + Revel.
The rooftop bar, Copper Spirits & Sights, serves Canadian whiskey, seasonal craft cocktails and elevated small plates.
The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel's pet program welcomes dogs with a doggy bed, bowls and cookies.

highlights.text: Copper Spirits & Sights is Ottawa's highest rooftop lounge, with indoor and outdoor seating and panoramic views of Parliament Hill and ByWard Market.
The hotel is steps from the historic Parliament Buildings and the National Gallery of Canada.
The Presidential Suite features a terrace with dramatic city views and a private entrance.
Deluxe corner rooms have wraparound views and Canadian touches.

considerations.text: The rooftop bar's exterior patio is open on a weather-permitting basis.
Guests bringing a dog must tell the hotel before arrival, and all dogs must be housebroken.
WhataHotel notes the urban location can mean some street noise.
